title: 3.1-beta1 UI Navigate back issue
body:
Hi, I'm observing this UI issue:
* open the app from home screen using icon (shows the app, ok)
* navigate back (redraws the app but shows it again - issue)
* navigate back (shows app icon on home screen, ok)

* the way from app widget to app and back works ok, without 2x back issue.

I captured it on following screen recording:

https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/24793786/179582118-1eb4f3eb-96fc-4e08-a5e4-b928ae532b44.mp4

Same issue during bolusing...
* start bolusing in aaps
* show android home screen (using android circle button)
* open aaps using app icon opens this screen with bolus indication as background task
![AndroidAPS1](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/24793786/179400097-341bef1a-41f0-4c9f-a9b9-d4786a40a862.jpg)

* here navigate back opens another screen with bolus indicator as modal dialog (here unable to navigate back, ok, but circle button works)
![AndroidAPS2](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/24793786/179400105-52566266-cd35-459c-99fe-1da23d0eeba2.jpg)


Using Samsung GALAXY S10 Lite, Android 12, One UI 4.1
